newsitem.title: UK: Bernard Matthews current yr profits ahead.
newsitem.headline: Bernard Matthews current yr profits ahead.

text.p: Food manufacturer Bernard Matthews Plc said on Wednesday current year profits were running ahead of the same period in 1996, but it faced an uncertain outlook due partly to the strength of sterling.
"In addition the price of soyabean meal, a major component of our animal feed, is rising to record highs," the company said in a statement with its annual results.
The group said its new value-added products factories in Britain and Hungary were now in production, but were not expected to make a significant contribution to profits until the end of 1997.
